intro.h2: Remodeling that turns out better than you pictured
paragraphs: Turn Key Creations is a remodeler offering home remodeling in East Tennessee, from complete basement finishes to new decks and covered porches. Basement remodeling is the work customers mention most often in their Google reviews, and every one of those reviews gives five stars.

One family had Turn Key Creations finish their basement from the studs up. Jamison made a lot of great suggestions and did their layout and design, and they say the project turned out way better than they had even pictured. The crew was polite, showed up each day ready to work and cleaned up every day, with no rushing and no shortcuts.

items.name: Basement finishing and remodeling
items.blurb: Turn an unfinished basement into real living space, or remodel one that no longer works. Customers have had complete basement finishes from the studs up, and one says the crew did the remodel exactly as they wanted, plus a little extra work, under the quoted amount.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a newly finished basement family room in a modern farmhouse-style home: warm white walls, light oak-look vinyl plank floor, recessed ceiling lights, a wet bar with warm wood shaker cabinets and a stone-look backsplash, a sectional sofa facing a media wall, daylight from a window well. Colors of warm wood brown, cream and soft amber. No people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.
image.alt: Finished basement family room with a wet bar, wood cabinets and recessed lighting

items.name: Decks
items.blurb: A new deck gives you a place to sit outside and enjoy the view. One customer says Turn Key Creations did an awesome job on her deck, finished on time, cleaned up after themselves and stayed within the budget. In her words, we love our new deck.

image.alt: Raised wood deck with railings and a covered section on tall posts

items.name: Covered decks and porches
items.blurb: A roof over the deck means you can use it in rain, sun or snow. The photos on the Turn Key Creations Google profile show covered decks with exposed wood rafters, sturdy posts and wood railings, built to look out over the yard and the sunset.

image.alt: Covered wood deck with exposed rafters and railings looking out over a snowy field

items.name: Outdoor living spaces
items.blurb: Outdoor rooms can be more than a deck. One photo on the company's Google profile shows a timber-frame pavilion with a stone fireplace and chimney beside the house, a covered spot for cooking and gathering that works well into the cooler months.

image.alt: Timber-frame covered patio with a tall stone fireplace beside a gray board and batten house

about.text: Turn Key Creations, TKC for short, is a remodeler that finishes and remodels basements and builds decks, covered porches and outdoor living spaces. Customers name Jamison, Toby and Drew as part of the crew, and Jamison handles layout and design, with a knack for seeing the final product before it is built. Reviewers call them nice guys and a great group, and say they are polite, well mannered and ready to work each day. The office is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and in the company's own words, the goal is to bring your vision into reality.
about.owner_role: Not found. Reviews name Jamison (layout and design), Toby and Drew; owner replies are signed as TKC.

process.h2: How a Turn Key Creations project works

steps.title: Talk about your space
steps.text: Call (865) 296-9868 on a weekday and tell the team about your basement, deck or other project and what you hope it becomes.

steps.title: Layout and design
steps.text: Jamison works out the layout and design with you and suggests ideas, helping you picture the finished space.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: You get a quoted amount for the job. Customers say projects stayed within budget, and one came in under the quote.

steps.title: Build and clean up
steps.text: The crew shows up each day ready to work, takes no shortcuts and cleans up every day until your project is finished.

items.name: Mei Shuen B.
items.text: We had Turnkey Creation do a complete basement finish from the studs up. We could not be happier. Jamison, Toby and Drew as well as the entire crew did a remarkable job. Each member of the team truly wanted to do their best work.  Everyone was polite and well mannered and showed up each day ready to work.  They were very neat and really cleaned up each day.  There was no rushing or taking shortcuts.  It really was a fantastic experience all the way around.  Jamison made a lot of great suggestions and did our layout and design.  He has a tremendous ability to see the final product and really had some great ideas.  Our project turned out way better than we had even pictured.  I would highly recommend Turnkey to anyone planning a building project.  What a great group of guys.  Thank you so much.

items.name: Paul M.
items.text: Not only did they perform the remodel work on our basement exactly as we wanted but they did a little extra work and came in under their quoted amount.  Nice guys, great work, highly recommend.

items.name: Trish G.
items.text: They did an awesome job, on time, cleaned up after themselves, and stayed within our budget!!!! We LOVE our new deck

service_area.text: Turn Key Creations comes to your home to do the work, whether that is a basement finish, a new deck or a covered porch. The Google listing does not show an address or a list of towns, so the quickest way to find out whether your home is in the area is to call (865) 296-9868 between 8 AM and 5 PM on a weekday.

items.a: Yes. Basement work is what customers mention most. One family had a complete basement finish from the studs up and says it turned out way better than they had pictured. Another had their basement remodeled exactly as they wanted, with a little extra work, and the job came in under the quoted amount.

items.q: Can you help with the design?
items.a: Yes. On one basement project, Jamison made a lot of great suggestions and did the layout and design. The homeowners say he has a tremendous ability to see the final product and really had some great ideas. Bring your own ideas too, and he can help shape them into a plan.

items.q: Do you build decks and covered porches?
items.a: Yes. One customer says the crew did an awesome job on her new deck, on time and within budget. The Google profile also shows covered decks with wood rafters and railings and a timber-frame patio with a stone fireplace. Call to talk about the outdoor space you want.

items.q: Will the crew keep my home clean?
items.a: Customers bring it up on their own. They say the crew cleaned up after themselves, and one family writes that they were very neat and really cleaned up each day during their basement finish. They also describe the team as polite and well mannered, and say they showed up each day ready to work.

Turn Key Creations is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (865) 296-9868 during those hours to talk about your project, or send a message through the Turn Key Creations Facebook page at any time.
